CustomField.description: Contact Id passed to Typeform via url parameter, then saved on Feedback Survey Response record. Url parameter passed via survey embedded in email template sent in Flow (Case_AccountSupport_SendSurveyResponseEmail OR CustomerSuccess_CoreOnboarding_SendSurveyResponseEmail) Used by flow (SurveyResponse_CreateLookupRelationships) to create the Contact Lookup relationship. Hidden on page layout for all users except Admins
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Hidden for all users except Admins. Used in automation to create Contact lookup.
CustomField.label: Contact Id
